title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World?
description: In a world where humans triumphed in a great war, Kai guards sealed crypts containing their enemies. But when “World Rebirth” overwrites history, he’s thrust into an alternate reality where humanity lost the war and he’s been forgotten by everyone he knows. Now, this lost hero must rise to restore the world’s balance!

episodes.title: S1-E1The Boy Forgotten by the World
S1-E5To the East of the World
S1-E12Those Who Shatter the Endless Cycle of World Reincarnation

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Kai's duty as a member of the Human Protection Agency is to ensure that the four races from The Great War are kept sealed in their graveyards. Humanity has been at peace for 100 years, until one day a portal opens and the world he's known ceases to exist.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: In the graveyard where the demons were entombed in his world, Kai finds a girl whom he cannot identify as any of the known races. When she asks him for help, he doesn't hesitate for long. After freeing her from her chains, mysterious things happen again.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After the demon attack on Neo Vishal, the resistance launches a major offensive against the demons and their heroine with the help of Kai and Rinne. But will Kai's knowledge from his world and Rinne's powers be enough to defeat the demons?

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: While Kai and Rinne confront the heroine of the demons, one of those mysterious beings reappears and tries to remove Vanessa from the world. However, Vanessa manages to fight it off. She then turns her attention back to Kai and Rinne.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: After finally driving the demons out of the capital, Urza's resistance sets out for the Federation of Io, whose resistance has requested support against the divine beings. However, it quickly becomes clear that not everyone welcomes this support.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Jeanne and Urza's resistance encounter remnants of the Io resistance in the Elfan Forest. Following the trail, they arrive at the Elf Village, where the leader of the elves is already waiting to present them with a proposal.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Urza's resistance, along with Reiren, confronts the Lord of the Heavens, Alfreya, who is attempting to subjugate the divine beings. However, Alfreya appears to possess powers that surpass even those of a hero.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Once again, a Last Riser seems to be connected to the sudden change in a hero's nature. Will Kai and his companions be able to defeat Alfreya? And what impact will this have on the relationship between humans and the divine beings?

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The spirit hero, "Spirit Sovereign Rikugen Kyoko" and the mythical beast hero, "Fang King Rath=IE" face off, with the fate of their races in the balance. Meanwhile, Kai and his companions head south to the Yulun Federation.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Guided by a mysterious voice, Kai, Rinne, and Jeanne enter Megalith. Awaiting them at the end is a stone statue of The Prophetic God Arsla Solaka. Kai is confused as he thought the Prophetic God was nothing more than a legend.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The resistance gets into a battle against the heroine of the spirit beings, but in the midst of it, a Last Riser appears. After the battle, they decide to get to the bottom of the mystery of the Last Risers. And so they proceed to the next tomb.

episodes_data.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A battle begins between Last Riser and Kai with Kyoko’s aid. Rinne, frozen out of fear, recalls her past with Sid. They manage to lure the monster out of the graveyard as all the races join forces to defeat one enemy; The enemy of the world, Last Riser.
